correctness.rationale: A matching observation pattern diagonalizes after row/column permutations, so every iterate stays in the orthogonal rank-one span and soft-thresholding acts coordinatewise. Before activation, \(y_j^{k-1}=(k-1)\delta s_j\), giving \(\kappa_j=\lfloor\tau/(\delta s_j)\rfloor+2\). After activation the amplitude obeys \(x_{j}^{k+1}-s_j=(1-\delta)(x_j^k-s_j)\); the activation bound and \(|1-\delta|<1\) prove persistence and exact rank monotonicity. At \(\delta=1\), one affine update settles each direction and yields the ceiling formula. Independent scalar replays across steps below, at and above 1 confirmed activation and persistence.
